notes.note: Reviewed final async receipt ownership and publication against installation/security claims. Promise rejection retains failed state; compound command/custody failure cannot reach verify, generated inputs, or a verified receipt. The reused-guard test relocates its open receipt first so Windows reaches the intended ownership refusal; original unchanged EPERM parity and repaired baseline/candidate parity were retained separately under #5647. No identity check, deadline or cleanup authority was weakened.
